items.title: The Broken Script
items.creator: 100Media
items.description:
Play as horror creatures in your world with The Broken Script skin pack. From glitched monsters to corrupted entities, use these skins to prank you friends!

+ 10 Horror Minecraft Skins
+ Made by 100Media

items.title: GOLEMS+ Add-On
items.creator: TNTgames
items.description:
With the GOLEMS+ Add-On, you can add new and unique golems to your world. Explore all new options for defending your base, clearing out monsters, and more!

+ 12 new golems
+ Unique attacks and animations
+ Special functions such as smelting and dynamic lighting

items.title: Meteorites Add-On
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
The sky is falling! Watch out below as meteorites can now plummet from the sky towards your world. Mine them and use the mysterious ore within to craft all new gear and decor!

FEATURES
- Naturally falling meteorites
- Tools to both summon and prevent meteorites from within an area
- Unique armour and weapons crafted from meteorite
- Unique decor items

By Pixel Squared

items.title: Cute Horror
items.creator: Heropixel Games
items.description:
Do you like creepy and cute characters?
Then the "Cute Horror" pack is perfect for you!

+ Includes 12 unique horror-themed skins
+ Great for roleplay and spooky adventures
+ Enjoy the fun and spooky vibes!

By Heropixel Games

items.title: Parkour Mechanics
items.creator: Skilendarz
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to build an amazing parkour course or traverse the world on a zipline? Now you can! Use wallrun blocks to run over gaps, jump pads to leap onto buildings, and fans to levitate! Compete with your friends on your courses and run from spinners as they try to push you off!

+ Ziplines & Parkour Flags
+ Jump Pads & Fans
+ Wallrun Blocks
+ & more!

items.title: Ducks
items.creator: Kora Studios
items.description:
Quack up your adventures with this skin pack! This charming collection features a variety of beautiful designs, perfect for adding a splash of fun to your day. From adorable to simple classics, each one brings a touch of feathered charm.

Includes 10 skins.

items.title: Backrooms Mansion
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Backrooms Mansion is here! 
Step into a haunted world where reality breaks apart. Explore endless, creepy hallways, discover secret rooms, and escape terrifying mobs lurking in the dark.

+Huge haunted mansion
+Underground levels
+Inspired by Backrooms creepypasta
+Horror textures
+Random jumpscares
+Horror role-play

You’ve just noclipped into Level 0… are you ready?

items.title: Neko Kitty
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
Step into a world of cuteness with these adorable kitty-themed teens! With fluffy ears and playful outfits, they’re always ready for a purr-fect adventure. Get ready for fun, meows, and endless cuddly moments!
- 12 skins
- 1 free skin

items.title: Gothic Demons 2025
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Unleash your style with the Demon 2025 skin pack! Dive into a dark, futuristic world where cool teens rock edgy fashion inspired by the shadows. Perfect for players looking to stand out in a realm of mystery and power. Embrace the vibe—be bold, be legendary!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: The Empty Zoo
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
Dive into the ultimate animal park experience with this massive, empty wildlife park! Perfect for adding your own touches.

+ Discover all 76 enclosures, terrariums, and aquariums available
+ Four diverse zones: Winter, Jungle, Water, and Savannah
+ Stunning eye-catching buildings
+ Compatible with animal Add-Ons

Become the owner of the largest Zoo and bring it to life!

items.title: Furniture + Add-On
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
FURNITURE + Add-On features over 1000+ furniture pieces! Craft new carpets, wallpapers, glass, doors, and more! This pack has interactable furniture blocks that can enhance any type of build. Whether your a Pro builder or a noob, this Add-On is perfect for any modern interior designer. 

+ Interactable Furniture
+ Compatible with other Add-Ons
+ By MobBlocks

items.title: Haunted
items.creator: KiwiStars
items.description:
Team up or go solo in this dark ghost-hunting adventure. Use paranormal tools, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the ghost’s home room... before it finds you.

- Multiplayer friendly
- By KiwiStars

items.title: SplitBlocks
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
This Add-On lets you combine two materials into a single block! Perfect for two-toned walls, ceilings, and detailed architecture. Great for modern builds or interiors, it adds depth and variety beyond vanilla blocks. Includes vertical slabs for even more creative freedom.

+ Made by Rafftrack Studio, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Neon Cyborgs
items.creator: Block Perfect Studios
items.description:
Light up the world with the Neon Cyborgs! Choose from bright, glowing robot teens and explore your world with style, speed, and power. Get ready to shine in every adventure!

-10 neon cyborg skins.
-Perfect for roleplay.

items.title: Construction Pack
items.creator: 5 Frame Studios
items.description:
Construction Pack brings you all of your construction necessities! Bulldozers, cement trucks, drills, and more. Add new buildings and construct your dreams!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Defeat The Boss
items.creator: Chillcraft
items.description: Prepare yourself for an epic journey through 5 challenging levels, each featuring a unique and powerful boss. Explore carefully, as each level hides secret chests filled with treasures to aid your quest. Find them all to increase your chances of victory. Good luck, adventurer!

items.title: Bricks Add-On
items.creator: Time Trap Studios
items.description:
Ever looked at your blocks and wished they had a bit more... brickiness? Now's your chance! With the Bricks Add-On, your Stonecutter becomes your ticket to transforming ordinary blocks into stunning, brick-inspired creations. Simply place your favorite block into the Stonecutter and select from a variety of brick styles!
- 749 new bricks
- By Time Trap Studios

items.title: Smurfs
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description: Step into the world of the Smurfs! Gargamel is causing trouble, and it's up to you to save the day. Rescue captured Smurfs, outsmart Gargamel in a potion battle, test your stealth against Azrael, and dash through parkour challenges. Explore Smurf Village to meet iconic characters like Papa Smurf, Smurfette, and Hefty Smurf.

items.title: Emo Icons
items.creator: Big Dye Gaming
items.description:
Designed to capture the essence of rebellion and artistry. Perfect for gamers who love to express themselves, these skins bring a fresh and edgy vibe to your virtual adventures.

• Featuring 10 unique teen Emo skins!
• Have fun!

By Big Dye Gaming

items.title: Emo Ghasts
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Emo ghastlings are sprouting up from the soil of the soul valleys! Toil in newfound emotions as new life reacts to the dark, cruel, and grueling landscapes they rise from! 
+ 6 emotional ghasts
+ Dark emo teen styles!

items.title: Tralalero HD
items.creator: Aliquam Studios
items.description:
Enjoy brainrot memes and wild characters? Join the trend and show off to your friends!

+ HD skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Aliquam Studios!

items.title: Angels & Demons Add-On
items.creator: Float Studios
items.description:
Choose Angel or Demon! Follow the path of good, or evil. Level up your Angel or Demon, become powerful, which side will you choose?

+ 24 Angel / Demon Armor pieces, each with abilities!
+ 12 unique weapons and attack abilities!
+ 11 Good and Evil mobs!
+ Level up your chosen side, and evolve your Angel / Demon Armor!
+ Find and conquer Monuments in your world!
items.changelog: NEW! - Paragon Levelling System, infinitely scaling levelling system once reaching maximum level! Increases Weapon and Armor ability power!

items.title: Magma Cave
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Survive in the Nether world! Start in a Magma Cave and defeat the Ender Dragon in a unique challenge.

- Begin with nothing - gather resources from the Nether civilization
- Meet special Nether Villagers
- Discover hidden structures and dangerous dungeons
- Race against time to defeat the Ender Dragon!

Can you master this scorching adventure and become a Nether hero?

items.title: Anime Monsters
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The Anime Monsters have been unleashed! Step into a world where epic anime energy meets monstrous power. This skin pack brings you cool skins inspired by legendary creatures reimagined in bold anime style. 

+ Perfect for RPG enthusiasts
+10 unique monsters
Made by Saturn Studios, published by Waypoint Studios.
